s: Shello lekabbot beyom tob ubo k"h seipim: asur lekabbot deleqa beyom tob, apillu roeh beto shennisrap, ella im ken yesh sham chashash sakkanat nepashot, sheaz muttar lekabbot apillu beshabbat, kemo shennitbaer besimman shl"d ayyen sham.

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshemmekabbeh mishshum hepsed mamono bilbad, abal im yesh tzorek akila bikbiyya zo, kegon sheadayin lo gamar seuddat yom tob, veim yissarep beto lo yihyeh lo maqom leekol sham veyapsid seuddato — muttar lekabbot, shehare kibbuy zeh hu ke"makshire okel nepesh" shemmuttar laasotan beyom tob. Abal im yukal leekol bemaqom acher, apillu bebet hannokri — asur lekabbot. Veim keshello yekabbeh yissarepu kele akila, veen lo kelim acherim leekol bahen beyom tob, vegam i epshar lishol kelim meacherim letzorek akilat yom tob, venimtza sheyyapsid seuddato im lo yekabbeh — muttar lekabbot kede lehatztzilam.
Beqaat haddoleqet umeashshenet et habbayit — asur lekabbotah, ap al pi sheen lo bayit acher lesheb sham veyitztarek lesheb beishshun enayim.

Veken asur lekabbot habbeqaat bishbil shello titashshen haqqedera veyippased hattabshil, shehare epshar lehatztzil haqqedera meishshun beli kibbuy al yede sheyyashlik habbeqaat lachutz. Veim hu tzarik libqaat zo shemmiqtzatah doleq yapeh umebashshel bo qederato, veen lo esh acheret lebashshel bah raq shel zo habbeqaat, vei epshar lo lehatztzil haqqedera meishshun raq al yede sheyyekabbeh miqtzat habbeqaat shehu mitashshen — muttar lekabbot, shehare kibbuy zeh letzorek "okel nepesh" hu mammash.

Asur lekabbot et hanner apillu tzarik lekabboto bishbil hanaat haggup, kegon sherotzeh leshammesh mittato veen lo cheder acher lehotzi et hanner lesham, ella yikpeh alayv et hakkeli, veal derek shennitbaer besimman ra"[z] ayyen sham, o yaaseh lepanayv mechitztza, veal derek shennitbaer besimman sht"v ayyen sham.

Ner shel shemen shehu doleq — asur lehagbiho qetzat kede sheyyistalleq hashshemen laachorayv velo yekabbeh et haesh, veen tzarik lomar sheasur lehistappeq mehashshemen shebbanner haddoleq, dekevan shemmesir shemen meat mehanner — hu gorem shehashshemen hannishar banner mitracheq meat meor haddoleq, veal yede zeh keheh oro qetzat, vahare zeh kimkabbeh.

Veken asur lehotzi petila haddoleqet bener apillu rotzeh lehannichah miyyad bener acher, demiyyad shemmotziah hu makheh orah, veen zeh moil kelum mah shemmannichah miyyad bener acher, o shemmachazirah miyyad leoto hanner. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshemmotziah legamre min hashshemen, abal muttar lehotzi miqtzatah haelyon chutz lashshemen kede shetteechoz haor bezeh hammiqtzat shehotzi mehashshemen utehe happetila doleqet yapeh. Veim eno yakol leechoz bappetila lehotzi miqtzatah chutz lashshemen mechamat shehashshemen samuk meod laesh haddoleq — muttar lehagbiah hanner meat kede sheyyistalleq hashshemen meat laachorayv veyukal leechoz bappetila ulehotzi miqtzatah kede shetteechoz bo haor, veachar kak yachazor viqareb hashshemen el haesh keshehaya, dekevan shebbehagbaha zo eno makheh legamre et or hanner, shehare miqtzat happetila nishara munnachat betok hashshemen, veal yede hagbaha zo yukal leharbot et oro yoter mimmah shehaya miqqedem, lepikak en kan chashash kibbuy kelal.

Ner shel shemen shehu doleq yapeh — muttar lehanniach betoko od petilot harbeh ulehadliqam kede sheyyikleh hashshemen bimhera, veen zeh domeh ligram kibbuy shehu asur kemo sheyyitbaer, kevan shehu oseh ken al yede ribbuy habara. Veken muttar likpol ner shel shaava ulehadliqo kede sheyyissarep bimhera, veken muttar lehattot ner doleq shel shaava o shel cheleb lehattik hashshaava o hacheleb kede sheyyikleh hanner bimhera, ap al pi sheal yede zeh gorem lemaher kibbuyo, mikkol maqom, kevan shehu oseh zeh al yede ribbuy habara — hare zeh muttar. Veken muttar leqatztzero al yede sheyyabirennu beemtzaito ad sheyyechalleqennu lishte nerot doleqot, apillu eno tzarik kelal lehadliq cheleq hashsheni ella kede sheyyissarep hanner bimhera. Abal asur leqatztzero al yede sheyyechattekennu millematta besakkin o bedabar acher, apillu im hu ner gadol meod vechas alayv shello yissarep kullo, mippene shehu gorem lemaher kibbuy hanner shello al yede ribbuy habara.

Abal muttar litten lematta sebibot hanner dabar hammoneo millehissarep beinyan sheyyikbeh kesheyyaggia lesham, kegon letochobo letok chol tichuach, beinyan sheen naaset bo guma kemo shennitbaer besimman ttz"ch, dekevan sheeno oseh maaseh begup dabar haddoleq, ap al pi shehu gorem lemaher kibbuy — en bekak kelum. Veap al pi sheasur ligrom kibbuy im lo bimqom hepsed kemo shennitbaer besimman shl"d, mikkol maqom, kevan shehaddabar hammunnach sebibot hanner eno mekabbeh mammash et haesh ella shehu monea oto millehissarep, lepikak lo gazeru bezeh mishshum geram kibbuy. Veken im munnachim harbeh chatikot cheleb o shaava betok hanner — muttar liqqach achat mehachatikot harechoqot mehappetila, shehare eno nogea begup dabar haddoleq, kevan shechatika shehu notel enah mechubberet im chatika haddoleqet.

Asur lehaamid ner doleq bemaqom sheharuach sholetet sham apillu en ruach menashsheb kelal, gezera shemma yaamidennu sham beshaa sheharuach menashsheb, venimtza ba lide kibbuy. Veap al pi shehu eno mitkavven kelal lekibbuy, mikkol maqom, kevan sheharuach menashshebet i epshar belo kibbuy. Veken asur liptoach delet o challon keneged ner haddoleq apillu en ruach menashshebet kelal, kemo shennitbaer besimman ra"z leinyan shabbat ayyen sham. Abal muttar liptoach keneged hammedura apillu beshaa sheharuach menashshebet, shehare eno mekabbeh ella mabir.
Asur lechammem ner shel shaava uledabbeqo bakkotel o bammenora, gezera shemma yemareach, dehaynu sheyyeshapshepennu lehachaliqo al pene shetach hakkotel, vehu toledet hamemacheq.

Ner shekkaba verotzeh lachazor ulehadliqo bo bayyom — muttar lachtok happecham shebberosh happetila kede shettehe nocha liddaleq apillu bikli hammeyuchad lekak. Abal im eno rotzeh lachazor ulehadliqo bo bayyom — asur lehasir happecham apillu beyado, shehare hu mekin miyyom tob lechol.

Ner shel battala, dehaynu sheeno tzarik lo kelal — asur lehadliqo beyom tob, shello huttera habara apillu shello letzorek "okel nepesh" ella im ken yesh bah tzorek hayyom qetzat. Abal im hu mitkavven leharbot bannerot likbod yom tob — en zeh ner shel battala. Vaapillu kebar berak al hannerot — yakol lehosip alehem od nerot lehadliqan likbod yom tob, veen zeh niqra ner shel battala, ella im ken mitkavven bannerot kede leharot oshro unedibato veeno mitkavven kelal bezeh likbod yom tob.

Veken kol ner shel mitzva, kegon nerot shel bet hakkeneset — en zeh ner shel battala, umuttar lehadliqan apillu beyom tob achar mincha. Veen bezeh mishshum mekin miyyom tob lechol, shehare behadlaqato yesh mitzva leotah shaa apillu en sham shum adam bebet hakkeneset, mippene shehu kebod hammaqom keshemmadliqin nerot lepanayv, shenneemar "al ken baurim kabbedu Hashem".

Abal asur letaqqen beyom tob rishon mehappetilot vehaashashiyyot shel nerot bet hakkeneset sheeno kede lehadliqan bo bayyom, veeno metaqqenan ella kede sheyyihyu mezummanim lo lehadliqan belel yom tob sheni, veken asur lehaamid hannerot shel shaava kede lehadliqan belel yom tob sheni, lepi sheasur lehakin shum hakana miyyom tob lachabero, apillu dabar sheen bo shum chashash melaka, kemo shennitbaer besimman tq"g. Umikkol maqom, muttar leadam lehadliq nerot bebeto beyom tob rishon samuk lachasheka, veen zeh kemekin miyyom tob lachabero, shehare ap beotah shaa shemmadliq hu tzarik leor hanner, kevan shekkebar hechshik hayyom.

Asur lehanniach ner doleq al gabbe ilan apillu meereb yom tob im rotzeh lehannicho doleq sham ad hallayla, gezera shemma yittelennu meal gabbe hailan liksheyyikbeh beyom tob, venimtza mishtammesh bimchubbar laqqarqa beyom tob, ayyen simman shl"v.

En pochatin ner shel cheres, dehaynu kesheodo rak kemo betzim shel yotzer umemaakim oto beyad laasot lo bet qibbul, ubeyom tob en laasot ken mippene shehu metaqqen keli. Veken asur littol mehanner et haqqash shemmesimin baaviro beodo rak kede shello yippelu haddepanot yachad ukeshemmityabbesh hanner notelin haqqash mimmennu, ubeyom tob asur littelo mippene shehu metaqqen keli, shezzehu gemar melakto.

Shene kelim shehen mechubbarim yachad bitchillat asiyyatan, kemo shedderek laasot shette kosot, o shette nerot debuqin zeh bazeh — en pochatin otam lishnayim beyom tob, mippene shehu metaqqen keli. Abal im lo nidbequ bitchillat asiyyatan raq achar kak nidbequ mimmela derek aray — muttar lepochotan apillu beshabbat, sheen kan tiqqun keli, kevan shekkebar hayu meporadin leachar gemar melaktan, ayyen sop simman sh"m.

Petila shehi arukka verotzeh leqatztzerah — asur leqatztzerah beyom tob, ben besakkin ben baur. Vaapillu rotzeh lepareq miqtzatah beyado — asur, mippene shehu kimtaqqen keli, sheoseh mippetila arukka petila qetzara. Veken im rotzeh lechalleqah lishte petilot — asur lechattekah besakkin o beyado, ella noten shette rasheha bepi shette nerot umadliqah baemtza, deaz en nikkar shemmitkavven letaqqen keli ella lehadlaqa bealma. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshetztzarik shette hannerot lehair o likbod yom tob, abal im eno tzarik ella leachat mehen veeno madliq hashshenit ella kede leqatztzer happetila shel harishona — hare zeh asur.

Asur laasot petila, dehaynu sheasur legodlah lekattechilla beyom tob, mippene shehu metaqqen keli. Abal im kebar hayeta gedula meereb yom tob ella sheenah qasha kol tzorkah — muttar lemaakah beyado kede lehaqshotah, mippene shehu tiqqun kilachar yad. Umuttar lishrotah beshemen qodem sheyyannichenna banner, raq sheyyizzaher millishrotah beshemen shebbener doleq, shehare memaet meat shemen mehanner, vahare zeh kimkabbeh, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Abal asur lehabheb (perush lacharok) otah beur kede shetteechoz bah haur yapeh, mippene shehu kimtaqqen keli.

Yesh limchot beyad miqtzat hehamon hannohagim beyom simchat tora lehabir mine nept sheqqorin pulevavi"r, deap shehem mitkavvenim lesimchat hayyom, mikkol maqom simcha zo enah shava lekol nepesh, veasur lehabir bishbilah beyom tob, kemo shennitbaer besimman tqy"a. Abal muttar liqboa pulevavi"r bishpoperet shettachub betokah ner shel shaava o shel cheleb, diksheyyaggia haur lesham yitbaer pulevavi"r meelayv. Veap al pi shehu gorem al yede zeh kibbuy hanner, mikkol maqom, kevan shehu mitkavven lemitzva — hittiru lo geram kibbuy, kederek shehittiru geram kibbuy bimqom hepsed mamono, kemo shennitbaer besimman shl"d.

Keshem sheen godelim petila lekattechilla beyom tob mippene shehu kimtaqqen keli — kak asur lehattir qeliatah beyom tob, mippene shehu kesoter keli. Veken ner qalua shel shaava — asur lehattir qeliatah beyom tob.

Asur lehasir happecham shebberosh hanner keshehu doleq, ben beyad ben bikli, mippene shehu mekabbeh happecham beyadayim. Veap al pi shekkibbuy zeh hu tzorek habara, sheal yede kak hanner doleq yapeh, mikkol maqom, kevan sheen behabara zo tzorek "okel nepesh" mammash ella kede lehair — asur lekabbot bishbilo, shemmeleket hakkibbuy lo huttera ella letzorek "okel nepesh" mammash, kemo shennitbaer besimman tq"z. Abal muttar lenappetz et happecham beetzbao, kevan sheeno mekabbehu beyadayim. Veen tzarik lomar shemmuttar lehattot beetzbao et rosh happetila kede shettidlaq yapeh.

Keshem shechayyab adam lehadliq bebeto ner echad lekol happachot beshabbat — kak hu chayyab beyom tob. Lepikak, tzarik lebarek bishat hadlaqa: "asher qiddeshanu bemitzvotayv, vetzivvanu lehadliq ner shel yom tob". Veoto ner shebberak alayv, hoil venitkavven bo leshem mitzvat hadlaqat nerot beyom tob, lepikak asur lehistappeq mimmah shennishtayyer mimmennu leachar shennikba, kegon im hu shel shuman asur leoklo beyom tob, ella yachazor veyadliqennu bo bayyom, o yamtin millehistappeq mimmennu ad motzae yom tob. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehidliqo qodem kenisat lel yom tob, dekevan shebbishat kenisat yom tob haya asur lehistappeq mimmennu mechamat shehuqtza kullo leshem hadlaqat mitzva, vehammistappeq mimmennu beshaa shehu doleq leshem mitzva hu mebazzeh et hammitzva, vekevan shenneesar mechamat muqtzeh bitchillat kenisat yom tob — neesar lekol yom tob kullo. Abal im hidliqo achar kenisat techillat lel yom tob — muttar lehistappeq mimmennu leachar shennikba, deen muqtzeh lachatzi shabbat, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"y ayyen sham. Umikkol maqom, beshaa shehu doleq asur lehistappeq min hashshuman hannotep mehanner, lepi shebbeshaa zo hu muqtzeh kullo lemitzvato. Abal muttar letaltelo leachar shennatap mehanner meelayv apillu beshaa shehanner doleq, shehare hu rauy lachazor ulehadliqo beotah shaa, veeno muqtzeh ella millehistappeq mimmennu.

Vekol zeh bener shebberak alayv, shennitkavven bo leshem iqqar mitzvat hadlaqat hanner beyom tob. Abal shear hannerot shemmosip likbod yom tob — muttar lehistappeq min hannotep apillu beshaa shehanner doleq. Veen tzarik lomar shemmuttar lehistappeq mimmah shennishtayyer min hanner leachar shennikba apillu nidlaq qodem kenisat lel yom tob. Veap al pi shebbitchillat kenisat yom tob lo haya yakol lachtok apillu meat shuman min hanner haddoleq mippene shehu gorem lemaher kibbuy, ukemo shennitbaer lemala, vekevan shenneesar lehistappeq mimmennu bitchillat kenisat yom tob neesar lekol hayyom kullo, mikkol maqom, kevan sheap bitchillat kenisat yom tob haya lo tzad hetter lehistappeq mimmennu, dehaynu al yede sheyyasim sebibot hanner dabar hammonea oto millisrop beinyan sheyyikbeh kesheyyaggia lesham veyukal lehistappeq mimmennu — nimtza shello neesar meolam.
